description.zh: 把 MineCodex 的提示词库接进 DSH：输入框「+」右侧多一个提示词按钮，点击弹出可搜索浮层，选中即填入输入框；侧边栏另有完整的管理页面。
description.en: Brings the MineCodex prompt library into DSH: a prompt button right of the composer's add control opens a searchable library that fills the draft, plus a full Prompt Preset panel in the sidebar.
